rejects.event: Niamey replaced Zinder as the capital of Niger.
rejects.quote: Niamey replaced Zinder as the capital of Niger in 1903, after a Tuareg revolt had weakened the eastern part of the territory.
rejects.why: The claim states the year is 1903, but historically Niamey became the capital in 1926 (as supported by candidate 2); the text in candidate 1 incorrectly pairs 1903 with this event.
